newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB signs up Italy-England soccer match.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB signs up Italy-England soccer match.

text.p: British Sky Broadcasting Plc has secured exclusive live television rights to the Italy vs England World Cup soccer qualifier, BSkyB said on Thursday.

The tie will be played in Rome on October 11 and is the final match for each country in their bid to qualify for the 1998 finals in France. Only the winners of the group are guaranteed a place in the finals.
As part of the deal, BSkyB has also bought the rights to Italy's World Cup matches at home to Moldova on March 29 and Poland on April 30. It plans to screen both matches live.
A BSkyB spokesman said there were no plans to show the Italy-England game on a pay-per-view basis. It would be available as part of the regular Sky Sports subscription.
BSkyB has the rights to all England's home matches under a deal which runs until 2001. The away games are sold on a match by match basis.
Channel 5, the new commercial channel due to launch on March 30, has bought the rights to the Poland-England World Cup game on May 31.
